resources.string: Lets Elimor act on the TV for you. In Launcher mode it covers the Amazon home and brings Elimor back when Home is pressed, holding back the remote\'s arrow keys meanwhile; with those options on in Elimor\'s settings, it also undoes a double power press and swaps Alexa\'s window for Elimor\'s voice assistant, which records your question and sends it to Google Gemini with your own key. In any mode, it taps the first stream in Stremio when Elimor opens a title with autoplay on, and taps Force stop in the system settings when you stop an app from Elimor. It keeps nothing it reads on screen.
